requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
Energy class D or better is preferred, so the filter includes all classes from A1 to D.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 45 people is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant is available from the RegulatoryAgent.
